description: Get the content of one file listed by open_kit. Save it exactly as returned, at the same relative path inside the new kit folder. Long files come in parts: if the answer says part 1/3, call again with part 2 and 3 and append them in order without changing anything.

part.description: Which part to get, for long files. Defaults to 1.

path.description: A file path exactly as listed by open_kit (e.g. CLAUDE.md, rules/FLOW.md).

ref.description: The link from the line the user pasted (https://nicetohave.app/g/XXXXXXXX-YYYYYYYYYY), or just the part after /g/ (everything, including after the hyphen).

name: get_kit_file
title: Get one file of an opened kit
